blocks.text: 🪝 Mandatory Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) Communication Fitment Mandated from Oct 1, 2028. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: MoRTH proposed mandatory fitment of V2V communication systems for all L, M, N category vehicles manufactured on or after **October 1, 2028** (DoT allocated 5.875–5.925 GHz band).
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
